<module id="multi_pipe_4bit">
    <description>4-bit unsigned number pipeline multiplier with two levels of registers.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal. Defined as 0 for chip reset and 1 for reset signal inactive.</input>
        <input id="mul_a" width_description="[3:0]">4-bit input signal representing the multiplicand.</input>
        <input id="mul_b" width_description="[3:0]">4-bit input signal representing the multiplier.</input>
        <output id="mul_out" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit product output signal.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="size">4</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description>
        <register id="partial_products" type="sequential_logic" width="8*size" description="Stores partial products."/>
        <register id="sum_reg" type="sequential_logic" width="8*size" description="Stores intermediate sum values."/>
        <wire id="extended_mul_a" width="8*size" description="Extended multiplicand with zero padding."/>
        <wire id="extended_mul_b" width="8*size" description="Extended multiplier with zero padding."/>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Extend inputs by adding 'size' number of zero bits at the most significant bit positions.
        assign extended_mul_a = {mul_a, {size{1'b0}}};
        assign extended_mul_b = {mul_b, {size{1'b0}}};

        // Generate partial products based on the multiplier's bits.
        genvar i;
        generate
            for (i = 0; i < size; i++) begin : partial_product_gen
                assign partial_products[i*8 +: 8] = (mul_b[i]) ? (extended_mul_a << i) : 8'b0;
            end
        endgenerate

        // Add partial products to get the intermediate sum.
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                sum_reg <= 8*size'b0;
            end else begin
                sum_reg <= sum_reg + partial_products;
            end
        end

        // Final product calculation.
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                mul_out <= 8'b0;
            end else begin
                mul_out <= sum_reg;
            end
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
